reason: Individual shared-controller pin PRs failed the provenance contract and launched expensive qualification before consistency was checked. Routine Go updates also competed with the authenticated security proposer.
changes: Run complete controller/collector consistency preflight before native and matrix jobs.
Group shared-controller Dependabot references into one discovery PR.
Use the authenticated security proposer for Go fixes; stop the separate routine-version PR queue.
rollout: Adopt the newly qualified immutable platform controller in a separate complete bundle after the platform repair is published. This bootstrap does not claim that rollout is complete.
approval: Independent human review is required after all CI passes.
